fields.name: Certificate number
fields.finding: The client's printed certificate shows casilla 4 = 34, which is the row number (column A) of the certified payee in the NOM_U_203 table (the same sheet's hidden helper XFD1 holds that payee's personnel number). The client therefore numbers certificates with a plain integer consecutive per tax-year table, with no year prefix. The draft designs a Mercans series 'AAAA-nnnnnn' (example '2026-000417') but declares Format 'N', which a hyphenated value cannot satisfy: the draft is internally inconsistent and differs from the client's practice. Both are permitted by the instruction guide quoted in the draft (number assigned by the issuer). Decision needed, no edit proposed: keep the Mercans series and change Format to AN, or follow the client's numeric consecutive.
fields.official_source: Form 220 instruction guide, casilla 4 ('asignado por la persona natural o juridica que expide la certificacion'), as quoted in the draft.

fields.name: Employer NIT
fields.finding: Format aligned: the client holds the NIT as 9 digits without dots, hyphens or DV, with the DV in a separate cell. NEW: the 34 payees certified in the client's Form 220 are booked in payroll organisation '1724 - PHILIP MORRIS COLOMBIA SA' (Acumulados), while the 261 September 2026 employees and the round-1 reports are organisation '1764 - Compañía Colombiana de Tabaco SAS'. The client file has one employer parameter block (DATOS), so a certificate run covers one withholding agent; which entity the masked DATOS name/NIT belongs to cannot be confirmed from the masked copy. The draft does not say how the employer block is chosen when the client runs more than one organisation.
fields.proposed_explanation: NIT of the withholding agent as it appears in casilla 5 of the RUT, WITHOUT the verification digit. The instruction guide is emphatic: 'En ningun caso escriba puntos, guiones o letras'. ONE WITHHOLDING AGENT PER CERTIFICATE RUN: the client keeps the employer block as a single parameter set (NIT as digits only, verification digit in a separate cell, razon social) and runs more than one payroll organisation - '1764 - Compañía Colombiana de Tabaco SAS' and '1724 - PHILIP MORRIS COLOMBIA SA' (the organisation in which the retirement-payment payees certified for tax year 2025 are booked). Company.NIT, Company.NIT_DV and Company.Legal_Name must be taken from the legal entity that made the payments and practised the withholding for each payee, and certificates must be generated per withholding agent.

fields.proposed_explanation: Identification number exactly as it appears on the identity document of the type in casilla 24, held as text (no dots, hyphens or spaces). Join key to the electronic payroll NIE045, to PILA Record Tipo 2 campo 4 and to Format 2276 numeral 2. SOURCE: the document-number column of the employee master that matches casilla 24 ('Citizenship Card ID', 'Indentity Card for Foreigners', 'National ID' or 'Identity Card'). In the client's Accumulated Report the column 'EE Citizenship Card ID' carries the document number for 248 of 261 employees and is blank for most holders of a foreigner's card (13 blanks, all foreigner-card holders); it is not a complete source. Do NOT use the column 'ID Number' of the Accumulated Report or of the Base of Withholding: it is the internal employee number (equal to Master Data 'Employee ID' for 261 of 261 employees), not an identity document; both reports also end with footer rows ('GRAND TOTAL'; 'Confidential' in Master Data) that must be excluded. COVERAGE GAP: the Accumulated Report has 1,038 payees, of whom 777 (491 pension payees of 62154 and 286 others, 132 of them paid 62100 Ordinary Salary in September 2026) have no row in the employee master data report, so a document-number source is missing for them. CLIENT EVIDENCE (tax-year-2025 Form 220 working table): for the 34 retirement-payment payees certified (wage types 62151 / 62152, none in the employee master), casilla 25 equals the Accumulated Report column 'EE Citizenship Card ID' in 34 of 34 cases and never the 'Beneficiary National Id'; casillas 26-29 carry split names, which the Accumulated Report does not hold, so the client keeps an identity source for non-employee payees that has not been received and must be named (see Query to RA).

fields.name: Retirement, old-age or invalidity pensions

report_evidence.column: AV33 ('Pensiones de jubilacion, vejez o invalidez', 50)

fields.finding: CANDIDATE CONFLICT. The draft's rule: pension income paid by the employer goes to casilla 50 (ET art. 206 num. 5); 62151 and 62152 are listed as candidate pension wage types under query (a). The client's tax-year-2025 certificates put 0 in casilla 50 for all 34 payees and certify their full income in casilla 46. All 34 are recipients of 62151 Retirement Payment - PRV (26) or 62152 Retirement Payment - Catleya (8); 22 of the 23 payees with casilla 60 > 0 carry 21140 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Retirees. Whether these 'retirement payments' are pensions (casilla 50) or another work-income payment (casilla 46) depends on what 'PRV' and 'Catleya' designate, which the data does not say - so the conflict is conditional on the RA's answer to query (a). None of the 577 holders of 62154 Monthly Retired Pension in the Acumulados appears in the 34 populated rows; the client's casilla for the monthly pensioners is NOT evidenced (617 of 651 rows are empty in the values-only copy). Draft-internal point for the RA: Field Options D38 says 'Taxable only above 1,000 UVT per month; below that, certified at zero', which a developer could read as casilla 50 = 0 below the threshold; the casilla-52 definition ('GROSS income') implies the full pension is certified.
fields.proposed_explanation: Pension income paid BY THE EMPLOYER. Taxable only above 1,000 UVT per month (COP 52,374,000 in 2026) under ET art. 206 num. 5. THIS CLIENT IS A PENSION PAYER: its accumulations carry 62154 Monthly Retired  Pension-6798 (491 pension payees, about COP 600-660 million a month), 62153 Additional Retirement Pension (paid in December and June), 62151 Retirement Payment - PRV-6795, 62152 Retirement Payment - Catleya-6796, 62115 Retirement Allowance, 62830 Pensioner Allowance-6794 and 62155 Medical Plan - Healthcare Insurance (EPS ) Pensioner- PMI Offset Compensation; the RA must confirm which of these are pension income for this casilla. Pension payees are NOT in the client's employee master data report, so their identification (casillas 24-29) needs a pensioner master source. On 330 of the 491 pension rows of 62154 the client records a 'Beneficiary National Id' different from the pensioner's own document (and on 328 rows a 'Beneficiary Name' different from the employee name), i.e. a different payee (substitute pensioner or third-party payee - to be confirmed); the same columns are also filled for employees, where they match the bank-payment beneficiary, so their meaning on pension rows is not confirmed. The RA and the client must confirm to whom the certificate is issued. Pensioner health and solidarity deductions (21645 / 21646 / 21647, 21643) feed casillas 53 and 54. CLIENT PRACTICE (tax-year-2025 Form 220 working table): the 34 payees certified are all recipients of 62151 (26) or 62152 (8), none of 62154 and none in the September 2026 employee population; the client reports casilla 50 = 0 and the whole amount in casilla 46 'Otros pagos'. Withholding (casilla 60) is non-zero for 23 of them, 22 of whom carry 21140 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Retirees in the accumulations. The client's casilla for the 62154 monthly pensioners is not evidenced.
fields.official_source: Form 220 printed label of casilla 50 'Pensiones de jubilacion, vejez o invalidez' (present in the client's CIR 2024 sheet) and ET art. 206 num. 5, as relied on by the draft. Not decided here.
